evidence.title: Genome-wide CRISPR/Cas9 screens reveal shared and cell-specific mechanisms of resistance to SHP2 inhibition.
evidence.authors: Wei W, Geer MJ, Guo X, Dolgalev I, Sanjana NE, Neel BG.
evidence.main_finding_zh: SHP2位于SOS1/2上游。CRISPR筛查发现NF1、PTEN、LZTR1等缺失可造成SHP2抑制抵抗，部分改变通过ERK信号再激活发挥作用。
evidence.limitation_zh: 跨细胞模型的SHP2药物耐药图谱，不能直接量化EGFR患者的耐药概率；NF1缺失并不自动代表可从SHP2抑制剂获益。

evidence.title: SHP2 Inhibition Sensitizes Diverse Oncogene-Addicted Solid Tumors to Re-treatment with Targeted Therapy.
evidence.authors: Drilon A, Sharma MR, Johnson ML, Yap TA, Gadgeel S, Nepert D, Feng G, Reddy MB, Harney AS, Elsayed M, Cook AW, Wong CE, Hinklin RJ, Jiang Y, Brown EN, Neitzel NA, Laird ER, Wu WI, Singh A, Wei P, Ching KA, Gaudino JJ, Lee PA, Hartley DP, Rothenberg SM.
evidence.main_finding_zh: PF-07284892早期试验采用先SHP2单药、再加入先前失效靶向药的设计，展示部分其他驱动实体瘤病例在组合后出现肿瘤与ctDNA响应的概念验证。
evidence.limitation_zh: 摘要中的患者为ALK肺癌、BRAF结直肠癌、KRAS卵巢癌与ROS1胰腺癌，不能写成EGFR突变肺癌或奥希替尼加化疗后有效率证据。选择性病例无随机对照。

evidence.title: The SOS1 Inhibitor BI 1701963 as Monotherapy or in Combination with Trametinib in Patients with KRAS Mutation-Positive Solid Tumors.
evidence.authors: Jänne PA, Johnson ML, Li J, Pant S, Dünzinger U, Ilia L, Möldner K, Soh JE, Yamamoto N.
evidence.journal: Clinical cancer research : an official journal of the American Association for Cancer Research
evidence.main_finding_zh: 2026年三项I期研究合计94名KRAS突变实体瘤患者接受SOS1抑制剂BI1701963单药或联合曲美替尼；摘要结论为单药疗效有限，同时报告剂量限制毒性和药物相关严重肺毒性。
evidence.limitation_zh: 人群不是奥希替尼加化疗耐药的EGFR肺癌。摘要报告3名单药患者在首周期出现间质性肺病并死亡，研究者认为与药物有关；因此不得将SOS1加MEK方案据机制推演为常规安全有效治疗。

evidence.title: Therapeutic targeting of RAS-mediated resistance in oncogene-driven lung cancer.
evidence.authors: Facchinetti F, Friboulet L, Liao L, Peroni M, Nakazawa S, Zullo L, Aldea M, Pecci F, Makarem M, Alonso Garcia I, Minari R, Tuladhar B, Ngo K, Da Silva A, Bigot L, Odintsov I, Koivu MKA, Leonetti A, Samaniego J, Bernard E, Kwiatkowski DJ, Ricciuti B, Rotow JK, Luo J, LoPiccolo J, Florez N, Awad MM, Remon J, Loriot Y, Besse B, Barlesi F, Italiano A, Barbie DA, Paweletz CP, Gokhale PC, Feng WW, Tiseo M, Planchard D, Shaw AT, Jänne PA.
evidence.journal: Annals of oncology : official journal of the European Society for Medical Oncology
evidence.main_finding_zh: 在312例一线奥希替尼进展患者中发现35例RAS改变（11.2%，不是KRAS单基因频率），其中KRAS G12D为10例、G12C仅1例。两个获得性KRAS G12D/G12R患者源耐药模型显示奥希替尼与选择性KRAS G12D或pan-RAS抑制策略的协同，为临床试验提供依据。
evidence.limitation_zh: 临床队列主要是奥希替尼单药进展；摘要未给出奥希替尼联合化疗后独立队列结果。药物组合疗效证据来自患者源细胞/动物模型，不是患者联合治疗试验；不能将RAS 11.2%当作奥希替尼加化疗后KRAS耐药发生率。

evidence.title: The combination of osimertinib with Raf inhibitor overcomes osimertinib resistance induced by KRAS amplification in EGFR-mutated lung cancer cells.
evidence.authors: Lee TG, Kang HM, Kim SY, Kim HR, Kim CH.
evidence.main_finding_zh: 奥希替尼耐药细胞出现KRAS扩增与ERK/AKT活化；KRAS敲低降低信号并增加药物诱导凋亡。RAF抑制剂LY3009120与奥希替尼在细胞和异种移植瘤中协同，建立扩增节点的功能性机制线索。
evidence.limitation_zh: 临床前细胞/鼠模型；不能把拷贝数增益直接等同于体内驱动，也不能将LY3009120组合视为EGFR耐药后临床标准。基于既往TKI后T790M模型，不代表所有一线奥希替尼联合化疗进展。

evidence.title: Tumor Analyses Reveal Squamous Transformation and Off-Target Alterations As Early Resistance Mechanisms to First-line Osimertinib in EGFR-Mutant Lung Cancer.
evidence.authors: Schoenfeld AJ, Chan JM, Kubota D, Sato H, Rizvi H, Daneshbod Y, Chang JC, Paik PK, Offin M, Arcila ME, Davare MA, Shinde U, Pe'er D, Rekhtman N, Kris MG, Somwar R, Riely GJ, Ladanyi M, Yu HA.
evidence.journal: Clinical cancer research : an official journal of the American Association for Cancer Research
evidence.main_finding_zh: 配对肿瘤组织分析中，27例一线奥希替尼病例有5例旁路遗传事件，包括1例KRAS突变；同时发现组织学转化等机制，显示组织活检能补充血浆无法检出的进展机制。
evidence.limitation_zh: 小型回顾性选样队列；单个KRAS事件不能给出稳定频率或证明某种KRAS抑制联合临床有效。适用于奥希替尼后机制发现，非奥希替尼化疗后随机证据。

evidence.title: Sotorasib for Lung Cancers with KRAS p.G12C Mutation.
evidence.authors: Skoulidis F, Li BT, Dy GK, Price TJ, Falchook GS, Wolf J, Italiano A, Schuler M, Borghaei H, Barlesi F, Kato T, Curioni-Fontecedro A, Sacher A, Spira A, Ramalingam SS, Takahashi T, Besse B, Anderson A, Ang A, Tran Q, Mather O, Henary H, Ngarmchamnanrith G, Friberg G, Velcheti V, Govindan R.
evidence.journal: The New England journal of medicine
evidence.main_finding_zh: CodeBreaK100单臂II期证实sotorasib在经治KRAS G12C突变晚期NSCLC中的临床活性。该人群为以KRAS G12C为驱动的NSCLC，提供变体特异性药理与其他临床场景的治疗证据。
evidence.limitation_zh: 不是EGFR突变肺癌经奥希替尼或奥希替尼化疗后获得性KRAS旁路的验证；不能由单药试验推出EGFR加KRAS联合为获批标准。本文也不能用于认证2026年任何地区的适应证或招募状态。

evidence.title: False-Positive Plasma Genotyping Due to Clonal Hematopoiesis.
evidence.authors: Hu Y, Ulrich BC, Supplee J, Kuang Y, Lizotte PH, Feeney NB, Guibert NM, Awad MM, Wong KK, Jänne PA, Paweletz CP, Oxnard GR.
evidence.journal: Clinical cancer research : an official journal of the American Association for Cancer Research
evidence.main_finding_zh: 在58例EGFR突变NSCLC的血浆ddPCR研究中，2例检出的KRAS G12X均同时存在于外周血细胞；证明少数血浆KRAS可来自克隆性造血，而非肿瘤。
evidence.limitation_zh: 证明检测来源鉴别的必要性，不表示全部血浆KRAS均是假阳性；肿瘤来源需要组织、配对白细胞或其他正交证据，单靠VAF高低无法统一裁定。

evidence.title: Molecular landscape of osimertinib resistance in patients and patient-derived preclinical models.
evidence.authors: Lim SM, Yang SD, Lim S, Heo SG, Daniel S, Markovets A, Minoo R, Pyo KH, Yun MR, Hong MH, Kim HR, Cho BC.
evidence.main_finding_zh: 55例奥希替尼经治患者及患者来源模型的综合研究中，NRAS Q61K模型可对奥希替尼加曲美替尼产生再敏感，提示RAS旁路可维持EGFR被抑制后的存活。
evidence.limitation_zh: 临床样本图谱与耐药细胞/PDX功能实验混合；NRAS Q61K联合药物的恢复敏感来自模型，并非经奥希替尼加化疗后患者随机试验。

evidence.title: Acquired resistance to AZD9291 as an upfront treatment is dependent on ERK signaling in a preclinical model.
evidence.authors: Ku BM, Choi MK, Sun JM, Lee SH, Ahn JS, Park K, Ahn MJ.
evidence.main_finding_zh: PC9来源的AZD9291耐药模型出现持续ERK激活，伴HRAS G13R及MET表达升高；EGFR与MEK联用在体外和体内模型恢复药物敏感性。
evidence.limitation_zh: 是细胞与动物模型，HRAS改变与MET表达同时存在；不能据此断定HRAS G13R单独足以解释患者耐药，也没有验证奥希替尼加化疗之后的疗效。

evidence.title: RASA1 and NF1 are Preferentially Co-Mutated and Define A Distinct Genetic Subset of Smoking-Associated Non-Small Cell Lung Carcinomas Sensitive to MEK Inhibition.
evidence.authors: Hayashi T, Desmeules P, Smith RS, Drilon A, Somwar R, Ladanyi M.
evidence.journal: Clinical cancer research : an official journal of the American Association for Cancer Research
evidence.main_finding_zh: 大型NSCLC基因组数据与功能实验提示RASA1/NF1截断共突变可构成RAS/MAPK驱动背景；双RASGAP失活的细胞模型比单基因失活更敏感于MEK抑制。
evidence.limitation_zh: 该亚群多与吸烟相关；研究中16例RASA1/NF1双截断肿瘤均缺乏其他已知肺癌驱动，不能直接当作EGFR突变获得性奥希替尼耐药证据。其药敏结果是临床前结果。

evidence.title: Trametinib in Patients With NF1-, GNAQ-, or GNA11-Mutant Tumors: Results From the NCI-MATCH ECOG-ACRIN Trial (EAY131) Subprotocols S1 and S2.
evidence.authors: Wisinski KB, Flamand Y, Wilson MA, Luke JJ, Tawbi HA, Hong F, Mitchell EP, Zwiebel JA, Chen H, Gray RJ, Li S, McShane LM, Rubinstein LV, Patton D, Williams PM, Hamilton SR, Behrens RJ, Pennington KP, Conley BA, Arteaga CL, Harris LN, O'Dwyer PJ, Chen AP, Flaherty KT.
evidence.main_finding_zh: NCI-MATCH S1队列46例NF1失活突变实体瘤接受曲美替尼，观察到2例部分缓解（ORR 4.3%），其中一例为晚期肺癌，但未达到主要疗效终点。
evidence.limitation_zh: 组织类型混合、单臂、人数少；个别肺癌缓解不能证明EGFR耐药后NF1突变群体获益，也不能建立NF1阳性即应使用MEK抑制剂的规则。

evidence.title: Case Report: Trametinib in the treatment of patients with metastatic lung adenocarcinoma harboring NF1 mutation: a case series and literature review.
evidence.authors: Kim F, Borgeaud M, De Vito C, Tsantoulis P, Addeo A.
evidence.main_finding_zh: 2025年四例NF1致病改变的NSCLC病例系列中，两例纯合LOF、两例杂合LOF，经分子肿瘤委员会讨论后接受曲美替尼；最佳疗效仅一例疾病稳定，作者认为未观察到临床获益。
evidence.limitation_zh: 四例均为高度经治且无对照的病例，不能精确估计亚群疗效；仍提示不能把NF1失活或双等位基因丢失机械地转化为MEK抑制治疗建议，且不属于奥希替尼加化疗后专门队列。

evidence.title: Tumours with class 3 BRAF mutants are sensitive to the inhibition of activated RAS.
evidence.authors: Yao Z, Yaeger R, Rodrik-Outmezguine VS, Rodrik-Outmezguine VS, Tao A, Torres NM, Chang MT, Drosten M, Zhao H, Cecchi F, Hembrough T, Michels J, Baumert H, Miles L, Campbell NM, de Stanchina E, Solit DB, Barbacid M, Taylor BS, Rosen N.
evidence.main_finding_zh: 定义BRAF class I、II、III的不同RAS依赖性：class III低活性或失活BRAF可增强与RAS-GTP及CRAF的互作，肺癌/结直肠癌模型中的RAS信号常来自RTK。
evidence.limitation_zh: 以跨癌种机制实验为主；不是EGFR突变奥希替尼加化疗后患者疗效研究，不能据此为所有class III病例直接选择RTK药物。

evidence.title: Impact of BRAF Mutation Class on Disease Characteristics and Clinical Outcomes in BRAF-mutant Lung Cancer.
evidence.authors: Dagogo-Jack I, Martinez P, Yeap BY, Ambrogio C, Ferris LA, Lydon C, Nguyen T, Jessop NA, Iafrate AJ, Johnson BE, Lennerz JK, Shaw AT, Awad MM.
evidence.journal: Clinical cancer research : an official journal of the American Association for Cancer Research
evidence.main_finding_zh: 236例BRAF突变NSCLC按功能类别显示不同共变异和临床特征，支持按具体等位变异分层，class II/III更常伴RAS改变。
evidence.limitation_zh: 主要是BRAF驱动肺癌异质性回顾队列；不能替代EGFR治疗后获得性旁路BRAF的联合治疗证据。作者所用生存差异受分期与靶向治疗暴露等因素影响。

evidence.title: Efficacy and tolerability of osimertinib with dabrafenib and trametinib in BRAF V600E acquired EGFR-mutant non-small cell lung cancer: a case series.
evidence.authors: Lu K, Tse V, Altaie G, Husain H.
evidence.main_finding_zh: 12例获得性BRAF V600E的三药经验由3例本中心患者加9例已发表病例组成，报告首评部分缓解及持续控制的信号，支持分子复检后开展前瞻验证。
evidence.limitation_zh: 不是12例独立连续入组的前瞻队列；文献病例选择/发表偏倚明显，不能与后续试验跨研究比较有效率。摘要报告5/12减量、2/12停药及肺炎；未单列奥希替尼加化疗耐药人群。

evidence.title: Osimertinib plus selumetinib in patients with EGFR-mutated advanced NSCLC with BRAF alterations post-progression on first-line osimertinib: ORCHARD.
evidence.authors: Piotrowska Z, Goldberg SB, Goldman JW, de Langen AJ, Le X, Okamoto I, Riess JW, Yu HA, Nishino K, Novello S, Ponce S, Ambrose H, Smith PE, Tang KH, Lehman JM, Cho BC.
evidence.main_finding_zh: 2026年ORCHARD BRAF模块最终分析：16例BRAF融合或V600E患者接受奥希替尼加selumetinib，ORR为7%，中位PFS为3.4个月，69%发生至少3级不良事件；作者认为总体风险获益不支持继续评估该组合。
evidence.limitation_zh: 单臂小队列且混合BRAF V600E与融合，不能证明所有MEK抑制策略均无效，也不能把这一负面结果写成有效标准方案。入组为一线奥希替尼进展，不是奥希替尼联合化疗后专属队列。

evidence.title: Triple-Targeted Therapy With Encorafenib, Binimetinib, and Osimertinib in EGFR-Mutated NSCLC With Acquired BRAF Alteration After Osimertinib: A Single-Center Experience.
evidence.authors: Fan KY, Ku M, Munarriz BJ, Stockley T, Rabinovitch A, Liu G, Bradbury P, Leighl NB.
evidence.main_finding_zh: 2026年单中心5例接受encorafenib、binimetinib和奥希替尼组合：1例部分缓解并持续较久，其余4例进展，中位PFS为2.8个月；提示可出现个体长反应，同时总体活性有限。
evidence.limitation_zh: 混合V600E、V600E合并D594N及G469A，样本极小、无随机对照；不能将单例长期缓解外推为所有BRAF获得性耐药有效，亦不能从摘要确认奥希替尼加化疗后的独立疗效。

evidence.title: Acquired BRAF Rearrangements Induce Secondary Resistance to EGFR therapy in EGFR-Mutated Lung Cancers.
evidence.authors: Vojnic M, Kubota D, Kurzatkowski C, Offin M, Suzawa K, Benayed R, Schoenfeld AJ, Plodkowski AJ, Poirier JT, Rudin CM, Kris MG, Rosen NX, Yu HA, Riely GJ, Arcila ME, Somwar R, Ladanyi M.
evidence.journal: Journal of thoracic oncology : official publication of the International Association for the Study of Lung Cancer
evidence.design_detail: 患者耐药样本加CRISPR及患者衍生实验
evidence.main_finding_zh: 基于进展后患者样本、CRISPR模型及患者衍生细胞，证实获得性AGK/PJA2-BRAF融合能维持MEK/ERK信号并削弱奥希替尼抑制。EGFR加MEK或pan-RAF策略主要在模型中成立。
evidence.limitation_zh: 病例包括厄洛替尼后及厄洛替尼继奥希替尼后；不是奥希替尼联合化疗耐药的随机人群，体外协同不能替代临床有效性与安全性。

evidence.title: Tumor-Agnostic Genomic and Clinical Analysis of BRAF Fusions Identifies Actionable Targets.
evidence.authors: Chen MF, Yang SR, Tao JJ, Desilets A, Diamond EL, Wilhelm C, Rosen E, Gong Y, Mullaney K, Torrisi J, Young RJ, Somwar R, Yu HA, Kris MG, Riely GJ, Arcila ME, Ladanyi M, Donoghue MTA, Rosen N, Yaeger R, Drilon A, Murciano-Goroff YR, Offin M.
evidence.journal: Clinical cancer research : an official journal of the American Association for Cancer Research
evidence.main_finding_zh: 跨52种组织学的BRAF融合研究按同框、5端融合伴侣及完整激酶结构域评估致癌潜力；不同组织学的MAPK治疗表现不一，支持功能结构审查。
evidence.limitation_zh: 跨癌种基因组与临床回顾，疗效病例主要不是EGFR突变肺癌奥希替尼加化疗后；不能给本场景套用跨癌种缓解率。

evidence.title: ARAF Amplification in Small-Cell Lung Cancer-Transformed Tumors Following Resistance to Epidermal Growth Factor Receptor-Tyrosine Kinase Inhibitors.
evidence.authors: Kimura R, Adachi Y, Hirade K, Kisoda S, Yanase S, Shibata N, Ishii M, Fujiwara Y, Yamaguchi R, Fujita Y, Hosoda W, Ebi H.
evidence.main_finding_zh: EGFR-TKI耐药再活检队列发现ARAF扩增，部分病例伴小细胞肺癌组织学转化；提示RAF通路线索与谱系转化可能并存。
evidence.limitation_zh: 单中心、少量病例和拷贝数检测关联；未证实ARAF扩增单独造成转化或耐药，也未验证ARAF扩增对应的标准治疗。

evidence.title: BRAF fusions define therapeutic vulnerability and tyrosine kinase inhibitor resistance in non-small cell lung cancer.
evidence.authors: Wang K, Yi C, Ning X, Xiong D, Wang S, Wu X, Bao H, Jiang Y, Deng H, Tang F.
evidence.main_finding_zh: 97例保留激酶结构域BRAF融合NSCLC回顾分析区分原发与获得性融合；获得性融合常在EGFR-TKI后检测到，个别EGFR共突变患者从EGFR加MEK阻断获临床获益。
evidence.limitation_zh: 包括原发及获得性、不同治疗史；个例获益和回顾性基因组特征不能证明奥希替尼加化疗耐药后普遍有效，亦不能当作前瞻性治疗标准。

evidence.title: Type II RAF Inhibitor Tovorafenib in Recurrent/Refractory Melanoma or Other Solid Tumors With BRAF Fusions or CRAF/RAF1 Fusions or Amplification: Phase II FIRELIGHT-1 Substudy.
evidence.authors: Vieito M, Cabanas EG, Mehmi I, Gaudy-Marqueste C, O'Neil BH, Medina TM, Body AL, Arance A, Kummar S, Najjar YG, Bedard PL, Rankin A, Chu C, McKenna C, Hume S, Kopp LM, Lee J.
evidence.main_finding_zh: FIRELIGHT-1 II期亚研究在23例携带BRAF或RAF1融合/扩增的复发难治实体瘤中评估II型RAF抑制剂tovorafenib，观察到单药临床活性。
evidence.limitation_zh: 这是跨实体瘤小样本、非随机单药研究，包含黑色素瘤及其他组织学；没有提供可直接应用于EGFR突变奥希替尼加化疗耐药队列的效果估计，不能把此类药物当作该场景已获批标准。

evidence.title: Allele-Specific Mechanisms of Activation of MEK1 Mutants Determine Their Properties.
evidence.authors: Gao Y, Chang MT, McKay D, Na N, Zhou B, Yaeger R, Torres NM, Muniz K, Drosten M, Barbacid M, Caponigro G, Stuart D, Moebitz H, Solit DB, Abdel-Wahab O, Taylor BS, Yao Z, Rosen N.
evidence.main_finding_zh: 17种MEK1肿瘤相关突变的功能研究显示，等位变异对RAS/RAF依赖、反馈响应及MEK抑制剂敏感性不同；部分RAF非依赖性突变对变构MEK抑制不敏感，ATP竞争性策略在模型中仍可抑制。
evidence.limitation_zh: 泛癌等位基因功能实验，不是EGFR突变肺癌奥希替尼加化疗后临床疗效证据；不能将每种MAP2K1或MAP2K2变异统一匹配同一种MEK药。

evidence.title: Osimertinib plus Selumetinib in EGFR-Mutated Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer After Progression on EGFR-TKIs: A Phase Ib, Open-Label, Multicenter Trial (TATTON Part B).
evidence.authors: Yang JC, Ohe Y, Chiu CH, Ou X, Cantarini M, Jänne PA, Hartmaier RJ, Ahn MJ.
evidence.journal: Clinical cancer research : an official journal of the American Association for Cancer Research
evidence.main_finding_zh: TATTON Part B为47例MET阴性的EGFR突变NSCLC早期单臂队列；前治T790M靶向TKI组35例的ORR为22.9%、中位PFS2.8个月，整体34.0%和4.2个月，疗效与前治分层明显有关。
evidence.limitation_zh: 不是随机比较，也不是统一的一线奥希替尼联合化疗耐药队列；不能将整体ORR或早代TKI组较高活性直接用于奥希替尼加化疗后。

evidence.title: Osimertinib plus selumetinib in patients with EGFR-mutated advanced NSCLC with BRAF alterations post-progression on first-line osimertinib: ORCHARD.
evidence.authors: Piotrowska Z, Goldberg SB, Goldman JW, de Langen AJ, Le X, Okamoto I, Riess JW, Yu HA, Nishino K, Novello S, Ponce S, Ambrose H, Smith PE, Tang KH, Lehman JM, Cho BC.
evidence.main_finding_zh: 2026 ORCHARD BRAF模块纳入一线奥希替尼后有BRAF融合或V600E的16例；奥希替尼加selumetinib的ORR7%、中位PFS3.4个月，69%出现至少3级不良事件。作者认为风险获益不支持进一步评估该组合。
evidence.limitation_zh: 小样本非随机且BRAF异质性较高；阴性结果不能推出所有MEK策略均无效，但直接反对按BRAF/MAPK激活自动推荐这一具体组合；不是专门奥希替尼加化疗后队列。

evidence.title: MAP2K1 K57N Conferred an Acquired Resistance to Furmonertinib, Dabrafenib and Trametinib Combined Therapy in Advanced Lung Adenocarcinoma with EGFR Mutation and BRAF V600E.
evidence.authors: Tan X, Wu Z, Chen M.
evidence.main_finding_zh: 报告EGFR突变并获得BRAF V600E的肺腺癌在伏美替尼、达拉非尼和曲美替尼组合后，再活检检出MAP2K1 K57N，提示通路下游变异可能参与组合后的再耐药。
evidence.limitation_zh: 单病例关联，EGFR药物为furmonertinib而不是osimertinib；不能把检出K57N当作已经完成因果功能验证，更不能将它解释成继续相同MEK抑制更有效。

evidence.title: Clinical Activity of Mitogen-Activated Protein Kinase Inhibitors in Patients With MAP2K1 (MEK1)-Mutated Metastatic Cancers.
evidence.authors: Dankner M, Rousselle E, Petrecca S, Fabi F, Nowakowski A, Lazaratos AM, Rajadurai CV, Stein AJB, Bian D, Tai P, Belaiche A, Li M, Quaiattini A, Normanno N, Arcila M, Elkrief A, Johnson DB, Ladanyi M, Rose AAN.
evidence.main_finding_zh: 2025 JCO Precision Oncology系统汇总46例接受MAPK通路抑制治疗的MAP2K1突变跨癌患者，整体ORR28%、中位PFS3.9个月；不同功能类别与持续获益的关系支持进一步前瞻性验证。
evidence.limitation_zh: 来自已发表病例的跨癌种系统汇总，存在选择、发表偏倚及治疗异质性；不能直接提供EGFR突变、奥希替尼加化疗后耐药的应答概率或标准处方。

evidence.title: ERK inhibition effectively overcomes acquired resistance of epidermal growth factor receptor-mutant non-small cell lung cancer cells to osimertinib.
evidence.authors: Li Y, Zang H, Qian G, Owonikoko TK, Ramalingam SR, Sun SY.
evidence.main_finding_zh: 奥希替尼联合ERK抑制在部分耐药EGFR突变细胞和裸鼠移植瘤中增强凋亡、抑制生长，说明持续MEK/ERK输出可成为部分模型的脆弱点。
evidence.limitation_zh: 细胞与裸鼠模型，无患者疗效验证；不能作为奥希替尼加化疗耐药后的处方依据。

evidence.title: Hyperactivation of ERK by multiple mechanisms is toxic to RTK-RAS mutation-driven lung adenocarcinoma cells.
evidence.authors: Unni AM, Harbourne B, Oh MH, Wild S, Ferrarone JR, Lockwood WW, Varmus H.
evidence.main_finding_zh: EGFR或KRAS驱动的肺腺癌细胞需要约束ERK活性；DUSP6负反馈可防止ERK过度激活的毒性，DUSP6干预在模型中使信号超过可耐受范围。
evidence.limitation_zh: 主要为癌基因驱动肺癌细胞机制，不是奥希替尼加化疗后临床队列；DUSP6抑制与ERK抑制方向不同，不可互换。

evidence.title: ERK1/2 Inhibitor Ulixertinib in Pan-cancer Patients with BRAF Fusions or Non-V600E/K Mutations: Results from the NCI-MATCH ECOG-ACRIN Trial (EAY131) Subprotocol Z1L.
evidence.authors: Subbiah V, Zhao F, Kudchadkar RR, Sullivan RJ, Chen HX, Gray RJ, Wang V, McShane LM, Rubinstein LV, Patton D, Williams PM, Hamilton SR, Sundaresan TK, Conley BA, Tricoli JV, Arteaga CL, Wright JJ, Harris LN, O'Dwyer PJ, Chen AP, Flaherty KT.
evidence.journal: Clinical cancer research : an official journal of the American Association for Cancer Research
evidence.main_finding_zh: NCI-MATCH Z1L中，BRAF非V600或融合的重度经治跨癌种患者使用ulixertinib，未观察到完全或部分缓解；摘要报告ORR为0%，未显示明确临床活性。
evidence.limitation_zh: 单臂、小样本篮式人群，仅含少数肺癌，未研究EGFR驱动获得性耐药后的EGFR+ERK组合；阴性结果不支持按BRAF非V600/融合直接自动推荐ERK抑制剂。

evidence.title: ERK/GATAD2A/SAA1 axis drives osimertinib resistance via NF-κB and macrophage reprogramming in EGFR-mutated lung adenocarcinoma.
evidence.authors: Zhu J, Ren S, Cheng T, Shan G, Lin H, Huang X, Bian Y, Duan L, Hu Y, Wu Y, Zeng D, Ao Y, Liang J, Wang S, Zhan C.
evidence.journal: Journal of experimental & clinical cancer research : CR
evidence.main_finding_zh: 机制研究发现奥希替尼抑制ERK依赖的GATAD2A磷酸化，解除NuRD对SAA1的抑制；SAA1通过肿瘤TLR4/NF-κB与SPP1阳性巨噬细胞提供存活支持，SAA1中和联合奥希替尼在多种模型有效。
evidence.limitation_zh: 临床关联加细胞/类器官及动物功能模型，非治疗性临床试验；没有专门奥希替尼加化疗后疗效队列，也不能据此直接预测某患者SAA1药敏。

evidence.title: Inhibition of hTERT/telomerase/telomere mediates therapeutic efficacy of osimertinib in EGFR mutant lung cancer.
evidence.authors: Chen Z, Vallega KA, Wang D, Quan Z, Fan S, Wang Q, Leal T, Ramalingam SS, Sun SY.
evidence.main_finding_zh: 奥希替尼效应涉及c-Myc依赖的hTERT下调、端粒酶/端粒抑制及端粒损伤；端粒策略联合奥希替尼在耐药和患者源模型中有效，提供MYC下游效应端的研究线索。
evidence.limitation_zh: 该文不等于证明所有MYC维持均由ERK驱动；组合结果主要临床前，文中提及某药进入临床试验不等于该EGFR耐药组合已验证。

evidence.title: SFK/FAK Signaling Attenuates Osimertinib Efficacy in Both Drug-Sensitive and Drug-Resistant Models of EGFR-Mutant Lung Cancer.
evidence.authors: Ichihara E, Westover D, Meador CB, Yan Y, Bauer JA, Lu P, Ye F, Kulick A, de Stanchina E, McEwen R, Ladanyi M, Cross D, Pao W, Lovly CM.
evidence.main_finding_zh: SFK/FAK在持续EGFR抑制下可同时维持AKT与MAPK信号；干预SFK/FAK或两条下游轴可增强奥希替尼效应，模型中YES1扩增也可形成耐药旁路。
evidence.limitation_zh: 细胞和动物模型中的组合效果，不是奥希替尼联合化疗耐药后人体获益；YES1扩增与SFK激酶活性升高应分别记录，不能把所有pERK升高直接判为RAS/BRAF基因事件。

evidence.title: AXL confers intrinsic resistance to osimertinib and advances the emergence of tolerant cells.
evidence.authors: Taniguchi H, Yamada T, Wang R, Tanimura K, Adachi Y, Nishiyama A, Tanimoto A, Takeuchi S, Araujo LH, Boroni M, Yoshimura A, Shiotsu S, Matsumoto I, Watanabe S, Kikuchi T, Miura S, Tanaka H, Kitazaki T, Yamaguchi H, Mukae H, Uchino J, Uehara H, Takayama K, Yano S.
evidence.main_finding_zh: 奥希替尼可解除负反馈而激活AXL；AXL与EGFR/HER3关联维持细胞存活并推动耐受持留细胞出现；AXL抑制在初始或持留阶段改善模型抑瘤效果，临床样本高表达与低反应关联。
evidence.limitation_zh: 主体为功能模型并附人体表达关联；AXL表达不是AXL致病突变，也不能据此认定AXL抑制联合在奥希替尼加化疗后有效。

evidence.title: Drug tolerance and persistence to EGFR inhibitor treatment are mediated by an ILK-SFK-YAP signaling axis in lung adenocarcinoma.
evidence.authors: Shi R, Farnsworth DA, Febres-Aldana CA, Chow JLM, Sheena R, Atwal T, Gomez Marti JL, Li S, Thomas KN, Lee CM, Awrey SJ, McDonald PC, Somwar R, Dedhar S, Ladanyi M, Bennewith KL, Lockwood WW.
evidence.main_finding_zh: ILK促进EMT和药物耐受持留；抑制ILK通过削弱YAP激活提高奥希替尼敏感性。高ILK状态可在EGFR抑制期间持续存在并积累额外遗传和表型改变，人体样本有相关性。
evidence.limitation_zh: 功能证据主要来自模型，活检相关性不足以构成临床预测标志物；临床可用的ILK/YAP联用策略及化疗经治背景均未由该研究证实。

evidence.title: AXL phosphosite mapping links FAK1 and YAP1 signaling to erlotinib resistance in EGFR-mutant lung cancer.
evidence.authors: Creixell M, Taylor SD, Gerritsen J, Jiang M, Bae SY, Augustin T, Loui M, Boixo C, Minamino S, Gong V, Creixell P, White FM, Meyer AS.
evidence.main_finding_zh: AXL磷酸位点模型把FAK1识别为近端底物，并将SFK/ABL相关信号与YAP1介导持留连接；在体外联合干预可消除部分持留细胞，临床相关性来自厄洛替尼治疗背景。
evidence.limitation_zh: 研究重点是厄洛替尼及PC9模型，不是奥希替尼加化疗后临床试验；某一AXL磷酸位点的网络效应不能泛化成所有AXL表达异常的统一药敏。

evidence.title: Acquired Resistance to Third-Generation EGFR Tyrosine Kinase Inhibitors in Patients With De Novo EGFRT790M-Mutant NSCLC.
evidence.authors: Park HR, Kim TM, Lee Y, Kim S, Park S, Ju YS, Kim M, Keam B, Jeon YK, Kim DW, Heo DS.
evidence.journal: Journal of thoracic oncology : official publication of the International Association for the Study of Lung Cancer
evidence.main_finding_zh: 特殊de novo EGFR T790M背景的小系列中发现MTOR L1433S等耐药改变；CRISPR及细胞功能实验支持该特定MTOR变异经AKT信号形成奥希替尼旁路，mTOR抑制联合在模型中恢复敏感性。
evidence.limitation_zh: 只有少量特殊基因型患者且联合药敏来自模型；不能把任意MTOR/PIK3CA/PTEN改变、pAKT阳性或该四例背景外推为奥希替尼加化疗后mTOR组合标准。

evidence.title: Osimertinib with or without Chemotherapy in EGFR-Mutated Advanced NSCLC.
evidence.authors: Planchard D, Jänne PA, Cheng Y, Yang JC, Yanagitani N, Kim SW, Sugawara S, Yu Y, Fan Y, Geater SL, Laktionov K, Lee CK, Valdiviezo N, Ahmed S, Maurel JM, Andrasina I, Goldman J, Ghiorghiu D, Rukazenkov Y, Todd A, Kobayashi K, FLAURA2 Investigators.
evidence.journal: The New England journal of medicine
evidence.main_finding_zh: FLAURA2随机试验建立一线奥希替尼联合铂类/培美曲塞的临床疗效背景；本条用于界定既往方案与队列，而不用于判定进展时的RAS/BRAF机制。
evidence.limitation_zh: 主报告的PFS和响应结局不提供可直接引用的RAS/BRAF进展样本分母、克隆关系或匹配治疗疗效；不能用其疗效结论证明联合化疗耐药后的某一旁路机制。

evidence.title: Tumor Analyses Reveal Squamous Transformation and Off-Target Alterations As Early Resistance Mechanisms to First-line Osimertinib in EGFR-Mutant Lung Cancer.
evidence.authors: Schoenfeld AJ, Chan JM, Kubota D, Sato H, Rizvi H, Daneshbod Y, Chang JC, Paik PK, Offin M, Arcila ME, Davare MA, Shinde U, Pe'er D, Rekhtman N, Kris MG, Somwar R, Riely GJ, Ladanyi M, Yu HA.
evidence.journal: Clinical cancer research : an official journal of the American Association for Cancer Research
evidence.main_finding_zh: 配对治疗前后组织研究识别鳞状等组织学转化及MET、KRAS、RET、BRAF等离靶改变，直接说明只查血浆不足以完整解释奥希替尼耐药。
evidence.limitation_zh: 单中心、选择了可重复活检的病例；主要是奥希替尼单药背景，不是专门的一线奥希替尼加化疗后队列，不能把频率直接迁移。

evidence.title: Combined analysis of circulating tumor DNA and tumor tissue to overcome osimertinib resistance (OSIRIS); the second line osimertinib cohort.
evidence.authors: van der Wel JWT, Jebbink M, van den Broek D, Steinbusch LC, Theelen WSME, Ruiter G, Buikhuisen W, Burgers JA, Baas P, Vermeulen M, van der Noort V, Hashemi SMS, Bosch LJW, Monkhorst K, Smit EF, Boelens MC, de Langen AJ.
evidence.main_finding_zh: OSIRIS在二/三线奥希替尼进展后联合血浆、组织DNA/RNA及病理分析；两类取样捕获的机制互补，单一血浆检测有漏检风险。
evidence.limitation_zh: 51例特定后线队列及特定面板；研究内成功阈值不能作为所有平台的通用阈值，不能外推为联合化疗后每个RAS/BRAF事件的频率或药敏。

evidence.title: Single-cell DNA-seq depicts clonal evolution of multiple driver alterations in osimertinib-resistant patients.
evidence.authors: Chen J, Facchinetti F, Braye F, Yurchenko AA, Bigot L, Ponce S, Planchard D, Gazzah A, Nikolaev S, Michiels S, Vasseur D, Lacroix L, Tselikas L, Nobre C, Olaussen KA, Andre F, Scoazec JY, Barlesi F, Soria JC, Loriot Y, Besse B, Friboulet L.
evidence.journal: Annals of oncology : official journal of the European Society for Medical Oncology
evidence.main_finding_zh: MATCH-R在奥希替尼耐药患者中以单细胞DNA测序检验第二驱动与EGFR是否共存；4份可分析冻存样本中证实共存，并显示克隆异质性与序贯事件。
evidence.limitation_zh: 仅有限可用样本得到单细胞结论；不能根据任一患者的bulk组织或血浆共检出就自动认定同克隆，患者源模型的联合敏感性也不是该完整治疗序列的随机临床疗效。

evidence.title: P2.237: Baseline Co-Mutations and Acquired Resistance Mechanisms in EGFR-Mutated Advanced NSCLC: FLAURA2 Exploratory Analysis
evidence.authors: C.K. Lee; J. Robichaux; D. Planchard; J.C.-H. Yang; K. Kobayashi; K. Laktionov; Y. Yu; B. Biswas; J.-M. Maurel; S. Ahmed; K.H. Lee; J. Tan Chun Bing; D.A. Ezeife; G. Pinto; L. Koubkova; N. Valdiviezo; K. Barrett; A. Evans; R. Hartmaier; P.A. Jänne
evidence.main_finding_zh: 已从Crossref核实题名、作者、期刊、DOI及发表年月：这是一条真实的FLAURA2耐药探索分析会议摘要题录。仅据题录不提取任何RAS/BRAF发生率、分母、检测方式或治疗效果。
evidence.limitation_zh: Crossref无摘要正文；会议/期刊官网访问受限，未核对报告正文、海报、具体会议归属及联合组/单药组分母。不能称为已审WCLC或ESMO大会结果，也不能作为自动用药匹配依据。

evidence.title: 514MO Acquired mechanisms of resistance to first-line (1L) osimertinib with or without platinum-based chemotherapy (CT) in EGFR-mutated (EGFRm) advanced NSCLC: Preliminary data from FLAURA2
evidence.authors: C.K. Lee; J.P. Robichaux; P.A. Jänne; S-W. Kim; T.M. Kim; K. Kobayashi; D. Planchard; S. Sugawara; N. Yanagitani; T-Y. Yang; A. Markovets; P. Bhetaryia; L. Poole; Y. Rukazenkov; R.J. Hartmaier; J.C-H. Yang
evidence.main_finding_zh: 已从Crossref核实题名、作者、期刊、DOI及发表年月：这是一条真实的FLAURA2耐药探索分析会议摘要题录。仅据题录不提取任何RAS/BRAF发生率、分母、检测方式或治疗效果。
evidence.limitation_zh: Crossref无摘要正文；会议/期刊官网访问受限，未核对报告正文、海报、具体会议归属及联合组/单药组分母。不能称为已审WCLC或ESMO大会结果，也不能作为自动用药匹配依据。

unique_evidence.title: Tepotinib plus osimertinib in patients with EGFR-mutated non-small-cell lung cancer with MET amplification following progression on first-line osimertinib (INSIGHT 2): a multicentre, open-label, phase 2 trial.
unique_evidence.authors: Wu YL, Guarneri V, Voon PJ, Lim BK, Yang JJ, Wislez M, Huang C, Liam CK, Mazieres J, Tho LM, Hayashi H, Nhung NV, Chia PL, de Marinis F, Raskin J, Zhou Q, Finocchiaro G, Le AT, Wang J, Dooms C, Kato T, Nadal E, Hin HS, Smit EF, Wermke M, Tan D, Morise M, O'Brate A, Adrian S, Pfeiffer BM, Stroh C, Juraeva D, Strotmann R, Goteti K, Berghoff K, Ellers-Lenz B, Karachaliou N, Le X, Kim TM, INSIGHT 2 investigators.
unique_evidence.main_finding_zh: INSIGHT 2在一线奥希替尼进展、中心FISH确认MET扩增的主要分析人群中，联合tepotinib和奥希替尼的客观缓解率为50.0%（49/98）。
unique_evidence.limitation_zh: 非奥希替尼联合化疗后专属队列；单臂II期结果，检测阈值依赖具体方法，不能自动外推为普遍标准方案。

unique_evidence.title: Savolitinib plus osimertinib in epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR)-mutated advanced non-small cell lung cancer with MET overexpression and/or amplification following disease progression on osimertinib: primary results from the phase II SAVANNAH study.
unique_evidence.authors: de Marinis F, Kim TM, Bonanno L, Cheng S, Kim SW, Tiseo M, Chu Q, Proto C, Sacher A, Luo YH, Novello S, Hao D, Baik C, Bazhenova L, Lee JS, Cho BC, Cadranel J, Diep TB, Metro G, Narayanan P, Yoneshima Y, de Castro Carpeño J, Baldotto C, Nyhus C, Yang JC, Sequist LV, Levy B, Hartmaier R, Igwegbe I, Poole L, Xu W, Ahn MJ.
unique_evidence.journal: Annals of oncology : official journal of the European Society for Medical Oncology
unique_evidence.main_finding_zh: SAVANNAH在奥希替尼进展并高MET表达和/或扩增的人群探索savolitinib联合奥希替尼，主要人群采用IHC3+≥90%和/或FISH10+，支持富集程度影响研究选择。
unique_evidence.limitation_zh: 主要疗效队列为一线奥希替尼进展，标志物阈值在探索分析后调整；并非奥希替尼联合化疗后随机验证，IHC表达与扩增不可视作同一机制。

unique_evidence.title: Landscape of Acquired Resistance to Osimertinib in EGFR-Mutant NSCLC and Clinical Validation of Combined EGFR and RET Inhibition with Osimertinib and BLU-667 for Acquired RET Fusion.
unique_evidence.authors: Piotrowska Z, Isozaki H, Lennerz JK, Gainor JF, Lennes IT, Zhu VW, Marcoux N, Banwait MK, Digumarthy SR, Su W, Yoda S, Riley AK, Nangia V, Lin JJ, Nagy RJ, Lanman RB, Dias-Santagata D, Mino-Kenudson M, Iafrate AJ, Heist RS, Shaw AT, Evans EK, Clifford C, Ou SI, Wolf B, Hata AN, Sequist LV.
unique_evidence.main_finding_zh: 41例耐药活检队列发现获得性RET融合；在EGFR突变模型表达CCDC6-RET可造成耐药，双靶阻断恢复敏感性；2例患者提供概念验证。
unique_evidence.limitation_zh: 少量患者及临床前证据；不能将de novo RET肺癌单药标准套用为EGFR/RET联合已证实标准，也没有奥希替尼加化疗后专属结果。

unique_evidence.title: Genomic Profiling of Epidermal Growth Factor Receptor Mutation-Positive Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer after Progression on First-line Osimertinib: Phase II ORCHARD Study.
unique_evidence.authors: Yu HA, Tang KH, Markovets A, Hartmaier R, Smith PE, Cho BC, De Langen AJ, Goldberg SB, Goldman JW, Le X, Iwama E, Cosaert J, Riess JW, Piotrowska Z.
unique_evidence.journal: Clinical cancer research : an official journal of the American Association for Cancer Research
unique_evidence.main_finding_zh: ORCHARD探索一线奥希替尼进展后组织及血浆分子谱，显示多重耐药改变和组织学转化相关差异，支持再活检和并列机制判断。
unique_evidence.limitation_zh: 预设探索性分子分析，并非特定RTK联合方案的随机证明；检测到改变不等于驱动因果；非奥希替尼联合化疗后队列。

unique_evidence.title: HER2 amplification as a resistance mechanism to osimertinib and its successful treatment with trastuzumab deruxtecan: a case report.
unique_evidence.authors: Sharma M, Choudhury R, Dewan A, Choudhary SK, Venkatraman P, Pasricha S, Mehta A, Chufal K, Darlong LM, Batra U.
unique_evidence.main_finding_zh: 一例EGFR突变肺癌经奥希替尼及后续多线治疗后检测到ERBB2扩增，经IHC/FISH确认后接受HER2靶向ADC，报告系统和颅内缓解。
unique_evidence.limitation_zh: 单病例、多线序贯治疗而非奥希替尼与化疗联合后的前瞻性证据；HER2扩增、激活突变和IHC不能互换，缓解不证明RAS/ERK为唯一驱动。

unique_evidence.title: SOS1 inhibition suppresses the emergence of osimertinib resistance to generate a durable response in EGFR-mutant lung cancer.
unique_evidence.authors: Daley BR, Theard PL, Hughes JM, Finniff BA, Hofmann MH, Kostyrko K, Schenk RL, Vieira HM, Askew JW, Lewis RE, Kortum RL.
unique_evidence.main_finding_zh: SOS1抑制在EGFR突变NSCLC三维球体、药物耐受持留与获得性奥希替尼耐药模型中抑制适应性RAS效应器再激活，减少肿瘤起始细胞；联合治疗在小鼠停药后延缓再生长。
unique_evidence.limitation_zh: 细胞与小鼠机制研究；未证明EGFR患者临床获益，也未专门验证奥希替尼加化疗后进展人群。小鼠联合与奥希替尼单药均可明显缩瘤，延缓停药后再生长不等于已建立临床耐药可逆转。

unique_evidence.title: JAB-3312, a Potent Allosteric SHP2 Inhibitor That Enhances the Efficacy of RTK/RAS/MAPK and PD-1 Blockade Therapies.
unique_evidence.authors: Kang D, Wang Y, Lin Y, Ma WW, Morgensztern D, Leventakos K, Bi C, Ding Y, Xiong J, Yan M, Sun X, Wang P, Ma C, Wang Y.
unique_evidence.journal: Clinical cancer research : an official journal of the American Association for Cancer Research
unique_evidence.main_finding_zh: 变构SHP2抑制剂JAB-3312在RTK/RAS/MAPK靶向组合中抑制ERK再激活，奥希替尼联合在奥希替尼耐药NSCLC模型中显示活性。
unique_evidence.limitation_zh: 该文关于奥希替尼联合的支持主要来自临床前模型；文中两项试验的代表性响应病例不能据摘要判定为EGFR奥希替尼耐药病例。未验证奥希替尼加化疗后疗效。

unique_evidence.title: Genome-wide CRISPR/Cas9 screens reveal shared and cell-specific mechanisms of resistance to SHP2 inhibition.
unique_evidence.authors: Wei W, Geer MJ, Guo X, Dolgalev I, Sanjana NE, Neel BG.
unique_evidence.main_finding_zh: SHP2位于SOS1/2上游。CRISPR筛查发现NF1、PTEN、LZTR1等缺失可造成SHP2抑制抵抗，部分改变通过ERK信号再激活发挥作用。
unique_evidence.limitation_zh: 跨细胞模型的SHP2药物耐药图谱，不能直接量化EGFR患者的耐药概率；NF1缺失并不自动代表可从SHP2抑制剂获益。

unique_evidence.title: SHP2 Inhibition Sensitizes Diverse Oncogene-Addicted Solid Tumors to Re-treatment with Targeted Therapy.
unique_evidence.authors: Drilon A, Sharma MR, Johnson ML, Yap TA, Gadgeel S, Nepert D, Feng G, Reddy MB, Harney AS, Elsayed M, Cook AW, Wong CE, Hinklin RJ, Jiang Y, Brown EN, Neitzel NA, Laird ER, Wu WI, Singh A, Wei P, Ching KA, Gaudino JJ, Lee PA, Hartley DP, Rothenberg SM.
unique_evidence.main_finding_zh: PF-07284892早期试验采用先SHP2单药、再加入先前失效靶向药的设计，展示部分其他驱动实体瘤病例在组合后出现肿瘤与ctDNA响应的概念验证。
unique_evidence.limitation_zh: 摘要中的患者为ALK肺癌、BRAF结直肠癌、KRAS卵巢癌与ROS1胰腺癌，不能写成EGFR突变肺癌或奥希替尼加化疗后有效率证据。选择性病例无随机对照。

unique_evidence.title: The SOS1 Inhibitor BI 1701963 as Monotherapy or in Combination with Trametinib in Patients with KRAS Mutation-Positive Solid Tumors.
unique_evidence.authors: Jänne PA, Johnson ML, Li J, Pant S, Dünzinger U, Ilia L, Möldner K, Soh JE, Yamamoto N.
unique_evidence.journal: Clinical cancer research : an official journal of the American Association for Cancer Research
unique_evidence.main_finding_zh: 2026年三项I期研究合计94名KRAS突变实体瘤患者接受SOS1抑制剂BI1701963单药或联合曲美替尼；摘要结论为单药疗效有限，同时报告剂量限制毒性和药物相关严重肺毒性。
unique_evidence.limitation_zh: 人群不是奥希替尼加化疗耐药的EGFR肺癌。摘要报告3名单药患者在首周期出现间质性肺病并死亡，研究者认为与药物有关；因此不得将SOS1加MEK方案据机制推演为常规安全有效治疗。

unique_evidence.title: Therapeutic targeting of RAS-mediated resistance in oncogene-driven lung cancer.
unique_evidence.authors: Facchinetti F, Friboulet L, Liao L, Peroni M, Nakazawa S, Zullo L, Aldea M, Pecci F, Makarem M, Alonso Garcia I, Minari R, Tuladhar B, Ngo K, Da Silva A, Bigot L, Odintsov I, Koivu MKA, Leonetti A, Samaniego J, Bernard E, Kwiatkowski DJ, Ricciuti B, Rotow JK, Luo J, LoPiccolo J, Florez N, Awad MM, Remon J, Loriot Y, Besse B, Barlesi F, Italiano A, Barbie DA, Paweletz CP, Gokhale PC, Feng WW, Tiseo M, Planchard D, Shaw AT, Jänne PA.
unique_evidence.journal: Annals of oncology : official journal of the European Society for Medical Oncology
unique_evidence.main_finding_zh: 在312例一线奥希替尼进展患者中发现35例RAS改变（11.2%，不是KRAS单基因频率），其中KRAS G12D为10例、G12C仅1例。两个获得性KRAS G12D/G12R患者源耐药模型显示奥希替尼与选择性KRAS G12D或pan-RAS抑制策略的协同，为临床试验提供依据。
unique_evidence.limitation_zh: 临床队列主要是奥希替尼单药进展；摘要未给出奥希替尼联合化疗后独立队列结果。药物组合疗效证据来自患者源细胞/动物模型，不是患者联合治疗试验；不能将RAS 11.2%当作奥希替尼加化疗后KRAS耐药发生率。

unique_evidence.title: The combination of osimertinib with Raf inhibitor overcomes osimertinib resistance induced by KRAS amplification in EGFR-mutated lung cancer cells.
unique_evidence.authors: Lee TG, Kang HM, Kim SY, Kim HR, Kim CH.
unique_evidence.main_finding_zh: 奥希替尼耐药细胞出现KRAS扩增与ERK/AKT活化；KRAS敲低降低信号并增加药物诱导凋亡。RAF抑制剂LY3009120与奥希替尼在细胞和异种移植瘤中协同，建立扩增节点的功能性机制线索。
unique_evidence.limitation_zh: 临床前细胞/鼠模型；不能把拷贝数增益直接等同于体内驱动，也不能将LY3009120组合视为EGFR耐药后临床标准。基于既往TKI后T790M模型，不代表所有一线奥希替尼联合化疗进展。

unique_evidence.title: Tumor Analyses Reveal Squamous Transformation and Off-Target Alterations As Early Resistance Mechanisms to First-line Osimertinib in EGFR-Mutant Lung Cancer.
unique_evidence.authors: Schoenfeld AJ, Chan JM, Kubota D, Sato H, Rizvi H, Daneshbod Y, Chang JC, Paik PK, Offin M, Arcila ME, Davare MA, Shinde U, Pe'er D, Rekhtman N, Kris MG, Somwar R, Riely GJ, Ladanyi M, Yu HA.
unique_evidence.journal: Clinical cancer research : an official journal of the American Association for Cancer Research
unique_evidence.main_finding_zh: 配对肿瘤组织分析中，27例一线奥希替尼病例有5例旁路遗传事件，包括1例KRAS突变；同时发现组织学转化等机制，显示组织活检能补充血浆无法检出的进展机制。
unique_evidence.limitation_zh: 小型回顾性选样队列；单个KRAS事件不能给出稳定频率或证明某种KRAS抑制联合临床有效。适用于奥希替尼后机制发现，非奥希替尼化疗后随机证据。

unique_evidence.title: Sotorasib for Lung Cancers with KRAS p.G12C Mutation.
unique_evidence.authors: Skoulidis F, Li BT, Dy GK, Price TJ, Falchook GS, Wolf J, Italiano A, Schuler M, Borghaei H, Barlesi F, Kato T, Curioni-Fontecedro A, Sacher A, Spira A, Ramalingam SS, Takahashi T, Besse B, Anderson A, Ang A, Tran Q, Mather O, Henary H, Ngarmchamnanrith G, Friberg G, Velcheti V, Govindan R.
unique_evidence.journal: The New England journal of medicine
unique_evidence.main_finding_zh: CodeBreaK100单臂II期证实sotorasib在经治KRAS G12C突变晚期NSCLC中的临床活性。该人群为以KRAS G12C为驱动的NSCLC，提供变体特异性药理与其他临床场景的治疗证据。
unique_evidence.limitation_zh: 不是EGFR突变肺癌经奥希替尼或奥希替尼化疗后获得性KRAS旁路的验证；不能由单药试验推出EGFR加KRAS联合为获批标准。本文也不能用于认证2026年任何地区的适应证或招募状态。

unique_evidence.title: False-Positive Plasma Genotyping Due to Clonal Hematopoiesis.
unique_evidence.authors: Hu Y, Ulrich BC, Supplee J, Kuang Y, Lizotte PH, Feeney NB, Guibert NM, Awad MM, Wong KK, Jänne PA, Paweletz CP, Oxnard GR.
unique_evidence.journal: Clinical cancer research : an official journal of the American Association for Cancer Research
unique_evidence.main_finding_zh: 在58例EGFR突变NSCLC的血浆ddPCR研究中，2例检出的KRAS G12X均同时存在于外周血细胞；证明少数血浆KRAS可来自克隆性造血，而非肿瘤。
unique_evidence.limitation_zh: 证明检测来源鉴别的必要性，不表示全部血浆KRAS均是假阳性；肿瘤来源需要组织、配对白细胞或其他正交证据，单靠VAF高低无法统一裁定。

unique_evidence.title: Molecular landscape of osimertinib resistance in patients and patient-derived preclinical models.
unique_evidence.authors: Lim SM, Yang SD, Lim S, Heo SG, Daniel S, Markovets A, Minoo R, Pyo KH, Yun MR, Hong MH, Kim HR, Cho BC.
unique_evidence.main_finding_zh: 55例奥希替尼经治患者及患者来源模型的综合研究中，NRAS Q61K模型可对奥希替尼加曲美替尼产生再敏感，提示RAS旁路可维持EGFR被抑制后的存活。
unique_evidence.limitation_zh: 临床样本图谱与耐药细胞/PDX功能实验混合；NRAS Q61K联合药物的恢复敏感来自模型，并非经奥希替尼加化疗后患者随机试验。

unique_evidence.title: Acquired resistance to AZD9291 as an upfront treatment is dependent on ERK signaling in a preclinical model.
unique_evidence.authors: Ku BM, Choi MK, Sun JM, Lee SH, Ahn JS, Park K, Ahn MJ.
unique_evidence.main_finding_zh: PC9来源的AZD9291耐药模型出现持续ERK激活，伴HRAS G13R及MET表达升高；EGFR与MEK联用在体外和体内模型恢复药物敏感性。
unique_evidence.limitation_zh: 是细胞与动物模型，HRAS改变与MET表达同时存在；不能据此断定HRAS G13R单独足以解释患者耐药，也没有验证奥希替尼加化疗之后的疗效。

unique_evidence.title: RASA1 and NF1 are Preferentially Co-Mutated and Define A Distinct Genetic Subset of Smoking-Associated Non-Small Cell Lung Carcinomas Sensitive to MEK Inhibition.
unique_evidence.authors: Hayashi T, Desmeules P, Smith RS, Drilon A, Somwar R, Ladanyi M.
unique_evidence.journal: Clinical cancer research : an official journal of the American Association for Cancer Research
unique_evidence.main_finding_zh: 大型NSCLC基因组数据与功能实验提示RASA1/NF1截断共突变可构成RAS/MAPK驱动背景；双RASGAP失活的细胞模型比单基因失活更敏感于MEK抑制。
unique_evidence.limitation_zh: 该亚群多与吸烟相关；研究中16例RASA1/NF1双截断肿瘤均缺乏其他已知肺癌驱动，不能直接当作EGFR突变获得性奥希替尼耐药证据。其药敏结果是临床前结果。

unique_evidence.title: Trametinib in Patients With NF1-, GNAQ-, or GNA11-Mutant Tumors: Results From the NCI-MATCH ECOG-ACRIN Trial (EAY131) Subprotocols S1 and S2.
unique_evidence.authors: Wisinski KB, Flamand Y, Wilson MA, Luke JJ, Tawbi HA, Hong F, Mitchell EP, Zwiebel JA, Chen H, Gray RJ, Li S, McShane LM, Rubinstein LV, Patton D, Williams PM, Hamilton SR, Behrens RJ, Pennington KP, Conley BA, Arteaga CL, Harris LN, O'Dwyer PJ, Chen AP, Flaherty KT.
unique_evidence.main_finding_zh: NCI-MATCH S1队列46例NF1失活突变实体瘤接受曲美替尼，观察到2例部分缓解（ORR 4.3%），其中一例为晚期肺癌，但未达到主要疗效终点。
unique_evidence.limitation_zh: 组织类型混合、单臂、人数少；个别肺癌缓解不能证明EGFR耐药后NF1突变群体获益，也不能建立NF1阳性即应使用MEK抑制剂的规则。

unique_evidence.title: Case Report: Trametinib in the treatment of patients with metastatic lung adenocarcinoma harboring NF1 mutation: a case series and literature review.
unique_evidence.authors: Kim F, Borgeaud M, De Vito C, Tsantoulis P, Addeo A.
unique_evidence.main_finding_zh: 2025年四例NF1致病改变的NSCLC病例系列中，两例纯合LOF、两例杂合LOF，经分子肿瘤委员会讨论后接受曲美替尼；最佳疗效仅一例疾病稳定，作者认为未观察到临床获益。
unique_evidence.limitation_zh: 四例均为高度经治且无对照的病例，不能精确估计亚群疗效；仍提示不能把NF1失活或双等位基因丢失机械地转化为MEK抑制治疗建议，且不属于奥希替尼加化疗后专门队列。

unique_evidence.title: Tumours with class 3 BRAF mutants are sensitive to the inhibition of activated RAS.
unique_evidence.authors: Yao Z, Yaeger R, Rodrik-Outmezguine VS, Rodrik-Outmezguine VS, Tao A, Torres NM, Chang MT, Drosten M, Zhao H, Cecchi F, Hembrough T, Michels J, Baumert H, Miles L, Campbell NM, de Stanchina E, Solit DB, Barbacid M, Taylor BS, Rosen N.
unique_evidence.main_finding_zh: 定义BRAF class I、II、III的不同RAS依赖性：class III低活性或失活BRAF可增强与RAS-GTP及CRAF的互作，肺癌/结直肠癌模型中的RAS信号常来自RTK。
unique_evidence.limitation_zh: 以跨癌种机制实验为主；不是EGFR突变奥希替尼加化疗后患者疗效研究，不能据此为所有class III病例直接选择RTK药物。

unique_evidence.title: Impact of BRAF Mutation Class on Disease Characteristics and Clinical Outcomes in BRAF-mutant Lung Cancer.
unique_evidence.authors: Dagogo-Jack I, Martinez P, Yeap BY, Ambrogio C, Ferris LA, Lydon C, Nguyen T, Jessop NA, Iafrate AJ, Johnson BE, Lennerz JK, Shaw AT, Awad MM.
unique_evidence.journal: Clinical cancer research : an official journal of the American Association for Cancer Research
unique_evidence.main_finding_zh: 236例BRAF突变NSCLC按功能类别显示不同共变异和临床特征，支持按具体等位变异分层，class II/III更常伴RAS改变。
unique_evidence.limitation_zh: 主要是BRAF驱动肺癌异质性回顾队列；不能替代EGFR治疗后获得性旁路BRAF的联合治疗证据。作者所用生存差异受分期与靶向治疗暴露等因素影响。

unique_evidence.title: Efficacy and tolerability of osimertinib with dabrafenib and trametinib in BRAF V600E acquired EGFR-mutant non-small cell lung cancer: a case series.
unique_evidence.authors: Lu K, Tse V, Altaie G, Husain H.
unique_evidence.main_finding_zh: 12例获得性BRAF V600E的三药经验由3例本中心患者加9例已发表病例组成，报告首评部分缓解及持续控制的信号，支持分子复检后开展前瞻验证。
unique_evidence.limitation_zh: 不是12例独立连续入组的前瞻队列；文献病例选择/发表偏倚明显，不能与后续试验跨研究比较有效率。摘要报告5/12减量、2/12停药及肺炎；未单列奥希替尼加化疗耐药人群。

unique_evidence.title: Osimertinib plus selumetinib in patients with EGFR-mutated advanced NSCLC with BRAF alterations post-progression on first-line osimertinib: ORCHARD.
unique_evidence.authors: Piotrowska Z, Goldberg SB, Goldman JW, de Langen AJ, Le X, Okamoto I, Riess JW, Yu HA, Nishino K, Novello S, Ponce S, Ambrose H, Smith PE, Tang KH, Lehman JM, Cho BC.
unique_evidence.main_finding_zh: 2026年ORCHARD BRAF模块最终分析：16例BRAF融合或V600E患者接受奥希替尼加selumetinib，ORR为7%，中位PFS为3.4个月，69%发生至少3级不良事件；作者认为总体风险获益不支持继续评估该组合。
unique_evidence.limitation_zh: 单臂小队列且混合BRAF V600E与融合，不能证明所有MEK抑制策略均无效，也不能把这一负面结果写成有效标准方案。入组为一线奥希替尼进展，不是奥希替尼联合化疗后专属队列。

unique_evidence.title: Triple-Targeted Therapy With Encorafenib, Binimetinib, and Osimertinib in EGFR-Mutated NSCLC With Acquired BRAF Alteration After Osimertinib: A Single-Center Experience.
unique_evidence.authors: Fan KY, Ku M, Munarriz BJ, Stockley T, Rabinovitch A, Liu G, Bradbury P, Leighl NB.
unique_evidence.main_finding_zh: 2026年单中心5例接受encorafenib、binimetinib和奥希替尼组合：1例部分缓解并持续较久，其余4例进展，中位PFS为2.8个月；提示可出现个体长反应，同时总体活性有限。
unique_evidence.limitation_zh: 混合V600E、V600E合并D594N及G469A，样本极小、无随机对照；不能将单例长期缓解外推为所有BRAF获得性耐药有效，亦不能从摘要确认奥希替尼加化疗后的独立疗效。

unique_evidence.title: Acquired BRAF Rearrangements Induce Secondary Resistance to EGFR therapy in EGFR-Mutated Lung Cancers.
unique_evidence.authors: Vojnic M, Kubota D, Kurzatkowski C, Offin M, Suzawa K, Benayed R, Schoenfeld AJ, Plodkowski AJ, Poirier JT, Rudin CM, Kris MG, Rosen NX, Yu HA, Riely GJ, Arcila ME, Somwar R, Ladanyi M.
unique_evidence.journal: Journal of thoracic oncology : official publication of the International Association for the Study of Lung Cancer
unique_evidence.design_detail: 患者耐药样本加CRISPR及患者衍生实验
unique_evidence.main_finding_zh: 基于进展后患者样本、CRISPR模型及患者衍生细胞，证实获得性AGK/PJA2-BRAF融合能维持MEK/ERK信号并削弱奥希替尼抑制。EGFR加MEK或pan-RAF策略主要在模型中成立。
unique_evidence.limitation_zh: 病例包括厄洛替尼后及厄洛替尼继奥希替尼后；不是奥希替尼联合化疗耐药的随机人群，体外协同不能替代临床有效性与安全性。

unique_evidence.title: Tumor-Agnostic Genomic and Clinical Analysis of BRAF Fusions Identifies Actionable Targets.
unique_evidence.authors: Chen MF, Yang SR, Tao JJ, Desilets A, Diamond EL, Wilhelm C, Rosen E, Gong Y, Mullaney K, Torrisi J, Young RJ, Somwar R, Yu HA, Kris MG, Riely GJ, Arcila ME, Ladanyi M, Donoghue MTA, Rosen N, Yaeger R, Drilon A, Murciano-Goroff YR, Offin M.
unique_evidence.journal: Clinical cancer research : an official journal of the American Association for Cancer Research
unique_evidence.main_finding_zh: 跨52种组织学的BRAF融合研究按同框、5端融合伴侣及完整激酶结构域评估致癌潜力；不同组织学的MAPK治疗表现不一，支持功能结构审查。
unique_evidence.limitation_zh: 跨癌种基因组与临床回顾，疗效病例主要不是EGFR突变肺癌奥希替尼加化疗后；不能给本场景套用跨癌种缓解率。

unique_evidence.title: ARAF Amplification in Small-Cell Lung Cancer-Transformed Tumors Following Resistance to Epidermal Growth Factor Receptor-Tyrosine Kinase Inhibitors.
unique_evidence.authors: Kimura R, Adachi Y, Hirade K, Kisoda S, Yanase S, Shibata N, Ishii M, Fujiwara Y, Yamaguchi R, Fujita Y, Hosoda W, Ebi H.
unique_evidence.main_finding_zh: EGFR-TKI耐药再活检队列发现ARAF扩增，部分病例伴小细胞肺癌组织学转化；提示RAF通路线索与谱系转化可能并存。
unique_evidence.limitation_zh: 单中心、少量病例和拷贝数检测关联；未证实ARAF扩增单独造成转化或耐药，也未验证ARAF扩增对应的标准治疗。

unique_evidence.title: BRAF fusions define therapeutic vulnerability and tyrosine kinase inhibitor resistance in non-small cell lung cancer.
unique_evidence.authors: Wang K, Yi C, Ning X, Xiong D, Wang S, Wu X, Bao H, Jiang Y, Deng H, Tang F.
unique_evidence.main_finding_zh: 97例保留激酶结构域BRAF融合NSCLC回顾分析区分原发与获得性融合；获得性融合常在EGFR-TKI后检测到，个别EGFR共突变患者从EGFR加MEK阻断获临床获益。
unique_evidence.limitation_zh: 包括原发及获得性、不同治疗史；个例获益和回顾性基因组特征不能证明奥希替尼加化疗耐药后普遍有效，亦不能当作前瞻性治疗标准。

unique_evidence.title: Type II RAF Inhibitor Tovorafenib in Recurrent/Refractory Melanoma or Other Solid Tumors With BRAF Fusions or CRAF/RAF1 Fusions or Amplification: Phase II FIRELIGHT-1 Substudy.
unique_evidence.authors: Vieito M, Cabanas EG, Mehmi I, Gaudy-Marqueste C, O'Neil BH, Medina TM, Body AL, Arance A, Kummar S, Najjar YG, Bedard PL, Rankin A, Chu C, McKenna C, Hume S, Kopp LM, Lee J.
unique_evidence.main_finding_zh: FIRELIGHT-1 II期亚研究在23例携带BRAF或RAF1融合/扩增的复发难治实体瘤中评估II型RAF抑制剂tovorafenib，观察到单药临床活性。
unique_evidence.limitation_zh: 这是跨实体瘤小样本、非随机单药研究，包含黑色素瘤及其他组织学；没有提供可直接应用于EGFR突变奥希替尼加化疗耐药队列的效果估计，不能把此类药物当作该场景已获批标准。

unique_evidence.title: Allele-Specific Mechanisms of Activation of MEK1 Mutants Determine Their Properties.
unique_evidence.authors: Gao Y, Chang MT, McKay D, Na N, Zhou B, Yaeger R, Torres NM, Muniz K, Drosten M, Barbacid M, Caponigro G, Stuart D, Moebitz H, Solit DB, Abdel-Wahab O, Taylor BS, Yao Z, Rosen N.
unique_evidence.main_finding_zh: 17种MEK1肿瘤相关突变的功能研究显示，等位变异对RAS/RAF依赖、反馈响应及MEK抑制剂敏感性不同；部分RAF非依赖性突变对变构MEK抑制不敏感，ATP竞争性策略在模型中仍可抑制。
unique_evidence.limitation_zh: 泛癌等位基因功能实验，不是EGFR突变肺癌奥希替尼加化疗后临床疗效证据；不能将每种MAP2K1或MAP2K2变异统一匹配同一种MEK药。

unique_evidence.title: Osimertinib plus Selumetinib in EGFR-Mutated Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer After Progression on EGFR-TKIs: A Phase Ib, Open-Label, Multicenter Trial (TATTON Part B).
unique_evidence.authors: Yang JC, Ohe Y, Chiu CH, Ou X, Cantarini M, Jänne PA, Hartmaier RJ, Ahn MJ.
unique_evidence.journal: Clinical cancer research : an official journal of the American Association for Cancer Research
unique_evidence.main_finding_zh: TATTON Part B为47例MET阴性的EGFR突变NSCLC早期单臂队列；前治T790M靶向TKI组35例的ORR为22.9%、中位PFS2.8个月，整体34.0%和4.2个月，疗效与前治分层明显有关。
unique_evidence.limitation_zh: 不是随机比较，也不是统一的一线奥希替尼联合化疗耐药队列；不能将整体ORR或早代TKI组较高活性直接用于奥希替尼加化疗后。

unique_evidence.title: MAP2K1 K57N Conferred an Acquired Resistance to Furmonertinib, Dabrafenib and Trametinib Combined Therapy in Advanced Lung Adenocarcinoma with EGFR Mutation and BRAF V600E.
unique_evidence.authors: Tan X, Wu Z, Chen M.
unique_evidence.main_finding_zh: 报告EGFR突变并获得BRAF V600E的肺腺癌在伏美替尼、达拉非尼和曲美替尼组合后，再活检检出MAP2K1 K57N，提示通路下游变异可能参与组合后的再耐药。
unique_evidence.limitation_zh: 单病例关联，EGFR药物为furmonertinib而不是osimertinib；不能把检出K57N当作已经完成因果功能验证，更不能将它解释成继续相同MEK抑制更有效。

unique_evidence.title: Clinical Activity of Mitogen-Activated Protein Kinase Inhibitors in Patients With MAP2K1 (MEK1)-Mutated Metastatic Cancers.
unique_evidence.authors: Dankner M, Rousselle E, Petrecca S, Fabi F, Nowakowski A, Lazaratos AM, Rajadurai CV, Stein AJB, Bian D, Tai P, Belaiche A, Li M, Quaiattini A, Normanno N, Arcila M, Elkrief A, Johnson DB, Ladanyi M, Rose AAN.
unique_evidence.main_finding_zh: 2025 JCO Precision Oncology系统汇总46例接受MAPK通路抑制治疗的MAP2K1突变跨癌患者，整体ORR28%、中位PFS3.9个月；不同功能类别与持续获益的关系支持进一步前瞻性验证。
unique_evidence.limitation_zh: 来自已发表病例的跨癌种系统汇总，存在选择、发表偏倚及治疗异质性；不能直接提供EGFR突变、奥希替尼加化疗后耐药的应答概率或标准处方。

unique_evidence.title: ERK inhibition effectively overcomes acquired resistance of epidermal growth factor receptor-mutant non-small cell lung cancer cells to osimertinib.
unique_evidence.authors: Li Y, Zang H, Qian G, Owonikoko TK, Ramalingam SR, Sun SY.
unique_evidence.main_finding_zh: 奥希替尼联合ERK抑制在部分耐药EGFR突变细胞和裸鼠移植瘤中增强凋亡、抑制生长，说明持续MEK/ERK输出可成为部分模型的脆弱点。
unique_evidence.limitation_zh: 细胞与裸鼠模型，无患者疗效验证；不能作为奥希替尼加化疗耐药后的处方依据。

unique_evidence.title: Hyperactivation of ERK by multiple mechanisms is toxic to RTK-RAS mutation-driven lung adenocarcinoma cells.
unique_evidence.authors: Unni AM, Harbourne B, Oh MH, Wild S, Ferrarone JR, Lockwood WW, Varmus H.
unique_evidence.main_finding_zh: EGFR或KRAS驱动的肺腺癌细胞需要约束ERK活性；DUSP6负反馈可防止ERK过度激活的毒性，DUSP6干预在模型中使信号超过可耐受范围。
unique_evidence.limitation_zh: 主要为癌基因驱动肺癌细胞机制，不是奥希替尼加化疗后临床队列；DUSP6抑制与ERK抑制方向不同，不可互换。

unique_evidence.title: ERK1/2 Inhibitor Ulixertinib in Pan-cancer Patients with BRAF Fusions or Non-V600E/K Mutations: Results from the NCI-MATCH ECOG-ACRIN Trial (EAY131) Subprotocol Z1L.
unique_evidence.authors: Subbiah V, Zhao F, Kudchadkar RR, Sullivan RJ, Chen HX, Gray RJ, Wang V, McShane LM, Rubinstein LV, Patton D, Williams PM, Hamilton SR, Sundaresan TK, Conley BA, Tricoli JV, Arteaga CL, Wright JJ, Harris LN, O'Dwyer PJ, Chen AP, Flaherty KT.
unique_evidence.journal: Clinical cancer research : an official journal of the American Association for Cancer Research
unique_evidence.main_finding_zh: NCI-MATCH Z1L中，BRAF非V600或融合的重度经治跨癌种患者使用ulixertinib，未观察到完全或部分缓解；摘要报告ORR为0%，未显示明确临床活性。
unique_evidence.limitation_zh: 单臂、小样本篮式人群，仅含少数肺癌，未研究EGFR驱动获得性耐药后的EGFR+ERK组合；阴性结果不支持按BRAF非V600/融合直接自动推荐ERK抑制剂。

unique_evidence.title: ERK/GATAD2A/SAA1 axis drives osimertinib resistance via NF-κB and macrophage reprogramming in EGFR-mutated lung adenocarcinoma.
unique_evidence.authors: Zhu J, Ren S, Cheng T, Shan G, Lin H, Huang X, Bian Y, Duan L, Hu Y, Wu Y, Zeng D, Ao Y, Liang J, Wang S, Zhan C.
unique_evidence.journal: Journal of experimental & clinical cancer research : CR
unique_evidence.main_finding_zh: 机制研究发现奥希替尼抑制ERK依赖的GATAD2A磷酸化，解除NuRD对SAA1的抑制；SAA1通过肿瘤TLR4/NF-κB与SPP1阳性巨噬细胞提供存活支持，SAA1中和联合奥希替尼在多种模型有效。
unique_evidence.limitation_zh: 临床关联加细胞/类器官及动物功能模型，非治疗性临床试验；没有专门奥希替尼加化疗后疗效队列，也不能据此直接预测某患者SAA1药敏。

unique_evidence.title: Inhibition of hTERT/telomerase/telomere mediates therapeutic efficacy of osimertinib in EGFR mutant lung cancer.
unique_evidence.authors: Chen Z, Vallega KA, Wang D, Quan Z, Fan S, Wang Q, Leal T, Ramalingam SS, Sun SY.
unique_evidence.main_finding_zh: 奥希替尼效应涉及c-Myc依赖的hTERT下调、端粒酶/端粒抑制及端粒损伤；端粒策略联合奥希替尼在耐药和患者源模型中有效，提供MYC下游效应端的研究线索。
unique_evidence.limitation_zh: 该文不等于证明所有MYC维持均由ERK驱动；组合结果主要临床前，文中提及某药进入临床试验不等于该EGFR耐药组合已验证。

unique_evidence.title: SFK/FAK Signaling Attenuates Osimertinib Efficacy in Both Drug-Sensitive and Drug-Resistant Models of EGFR-Mutant Lung Cancer.
unique_evidence.authors: Ichihara E, Westover D, Meador CB, Yan Y, Bauer JA, Lu P, Ye F, Kulick A, de Stanchina E, McEwen R, Ladanyi M, Cross D, Pao W, Lovly CM.
unique_evidence.main_finding_zh: SFK/FAK在持续EGFR抑制下可同时维持AKT与MAPK信号；干预SFK/FAK或两条下游轴可增强奥希替尼效应，模型中YES1扩增也可形成耐药旁路。
unique_evidence.limitation_zh: 细胞和动物模型中的组合效果，不是奥希替尼联合化疗耐药后人体获益；YES1扩增与SFK激酶活性升高应分别记录，不能把所有pERK升高直接判为RAS/BRAF基因事件。

unique_evidence.title: AXL confers intrinsic resistance to osimertinib and advances the emergence of tolerant cells.
unique_evidence.authors: Taniguchi H, Yamada T, Wang R, Tanimura K, Adachi Y, Nishiyama A, Tanimoto A, Takeuchi S, Araujo LH, Boroni M, Yoshimura A, Shiotsu S, Matsumoto I, Watanabe S, Kikuchi T, Miura S, Tanaka H, Kitazaki T, Yamaguchi H, Mukae H, Uchino J, Uehara H, Takayama K, Yano S.
unique_evidence.main_finding_zh: 奥希替尼可解除负反馈而激活AXL；AXL与EGFR/HER3关联维持细胞存活并推动耐受持留细胞出现；AXL抑制在初始或持留阶段改善模型抑瘤效果，临床样本高表达与低反应关联。
unique_evidence.limitation_zh: 主体为功能模型并附人体表达关联；AXL表达不是AXL致病突变，也不能据此认定AXL抑制联合在奥希替尼加化疗后有效。

unique_evidence.title: Drug tolerance and persistence to EGFR inhibitor treatment are mediated by an ILK-SFK-YAP signaling axis in lung adenocarcinoma.
unique_evidence.authors: Shi R, Farnsworth DA, Febres-Aldana CA, Chow JLM, Sheena R, Atwal T, Gomez Marti JL, Li S, Thomas KN, Lee CM, Awrey SJ, McDonald PC, Somwar R, Dedhar S, Ladanyi M, Bennewith KL, Lockwood WW.
unique_evidence.main_finding_zh: ILK促进EMT和药物耐受持留；抑制ILK通过削弱YAP激活提高奥希替尼敏感性。高ILK状态可在EGFR抑制期间持续存在并积累额外遗传和表型改变，人体样本有相关性。
unique_evidence.limitation_zh: 功能证据主要来自模型，活检相关性不足以构成临床预测标志物；临床可用的ILK/YAP联用策略及化疗经治背景均未由该研究证实。

unique_evidence.title: AXL phosphosite mapping links FAK1 and YAP1 signaling to erlotinib resistance in EGFR-mutant lung cancer.
unique_evidence.authors: Creixell M, Taylor SD, Gerritsen J, Jiang M, Bae SY, Augustin T, Loui M, Boixo C, Minamino S, Gong V, Creixell P, White FM, Meyer AS.
unique_evidence.main_finding_zh: AXL磷酸位点模型把FAK1识别为近端底物，并将SFK/ABL相关信号与YAP1介导持留连接；在体外联合干预可消除部分持留细胞，临床相关性来自厄洛替尼治疗背景。
unique_evidence.limitation_zh: 研究重点是厄洛替尼及PC9模型，不是奥希替尼加化疗后临床试验；某一AXL磷酸位点的网络效应不能泛化成所有AXL表达异常的统一药敏。

unique_evidence.title: Acquired Resistance to Third-Generation EGFR Tyrosine Kinase Inhibitors in Patients With De Novo EGFRT790M-Mutant NSCLC.
unique_evidence.authors: Park HR, Kim TM, Lee Y, Kim S, Park S, Ju YS, Kim M, Keam B, Jeon YK, Kim DW, Heo DS.
unique_evidence.journal: Journal of thoracic oncology : official publication of the International Association for the Study of Lung Cancer
unique_evidence.main_finding_zh: 特殊de novo EGFR T790M背景的小系列中发现MTOR L1433S等耐药改变；CRISPR及细胞功能实验支持该特定MTOR变异经AKT信号形成奥希替尼旁路，mTOR抑制联合在模型中恢复敏感性。
unique_evidence.limitation_zh: 只有少量特殊基因型患者且联合药敏来自模型；不能把任意MTOR/PIK3CA/PTEN改变、pAKT阳性或该四例背景外推为奥希替尼加化疗后mTOR组合标准。

unique_evidence.title: Osimertinib with or without Chemotherapy in EGFR-Mutated Advanced NSCLC.
unique_evidence.authors: Planchard D, Jänne PA, Cheng Y, Yang JC, Yanagitani N, Kim SW, Sugawara S, Yu Y, Fan Y, Geater SL, Laktionov K, Lee CK, Valdiviezo N, Ahmed S, Maurel JM, Andrasina I, Goldman J, Ghiorghiu D, Rukazenkov Y, Todd A, Kobayashi K, FLAURA2 Investigators.
unique_evidence.journal: The New England journal of medicine
unique_evidence.main_finding_zh: FLAURA2随机试验建立一线奥希替尼联合铂类/培美曲塞的临床疗效背景；本条用于界定既往方案与队列，而不用于判定进展时的RAS/BRAF机制。
unique_evidence.limitation_zh: 主报告的PFS和响应结局不提供可直接引用的RAS/BRAF进展样本分母、克隆关系或匹配治疗疗效；不能用其疗效结论证明联合化疗耐药后的某一旁路机制。

unique_evidence.title: Combined analysis of circulating tumor DNA and tumor tissue to overcome osimertinib resistance (OSIRIS); the second line osimertinib cohort.
unique_evidence.authors: van der Wel JWT, Jebbink M, van den Broek D, Steinbusch LC, Theelen WSME, Ruiter G, Buikhuisen W, Burgers JA, Baas P, Vermeulen M, van der Noort V, Hashemi SMS, Bosch LJW, Monkhorst K, Smit EF, Boelens MC, de Langen AJ.
unique_evidence.main_finding_zh: OSIRIS在二/三线奥希替尼进展后联合血浆、组织DNA/RNA及病理分析；两类取样捕获的机制互补，单一血浆检测有漏检风险。
unique_evidence.limitation_zh: 51例特定后线队列及特定面板；研究内成功阈值不能作为所有平台的通用阈值，不能外推为联合化疗后每个RAS/BRAF事件的频率或药敏。

unique_evidence.title: Single-cell DNA-seq depicts clonal evolution of multiple driver alterations in osimertinib-resistant patients.
unique_evidence.authors: Chen J, Facchinetti F, Braye F, Yurchenko AA, Bigot L, Ponce S, Planchard D, Gazzah A, Nikolaev S, Michiels S, Vasseur D, Lacroix L, Tselikas L, Nobre C, Olaussen KA, Andre F, Scoazec JY, Barlesi F, Soria JC, Loriot Y, Besse B, Friboulet L.
unique_evidence.journal: Annals of oncology : official journal of the European Society for Medical Oncology
unique_evidence.main_finding_zh: MATCH-R在奥希替尼耐药患者中以单细胞DNA测序检验第二驱动与EGFR是否共存；4份可分析冻存样本中证实共存，并显示克隆异质性与序贯事件。
unique_evidence.limitation_zh: 仅有限可用样本得到单细胞结论；不能根据任一患者的bulk组织或血浆共检出就自动认定同克隆，患者源模型的联合敏感性也不是该完整治疗序列的随机临床疗效。

unique_evidence.title: P2.237: Baseline Co-Mutations and Acquired Resistance Mechanisms in EGFR-Mutated Advanced NSCLC: FLAURA2 Exploratory Analysis
unique_evidence.authors: C.K. Lee; J. Robichaux; D. Planchard; J.C.-H. Yang; K. Kobayashi; K. Laktionov; Y. Yu; B. Biswas; J.-M. Maurel; S. Ahmed; K.H. Lee; J. Tan Chun Bing; D.A. Ezeife; G. Pinto; L. Koubkova; N. Valdiviezo; K. Barrett; A. Evans; R. Hartmaier; P.A. Jänne
unique_evidence.main_finding_zh: 已从Crossref核实题名、作者、期刊、DOI及发表年月：这是一条真实的FLAURA2耐药探索分析会议摘要题录。仅据题录不提取任何RAS/BRAF发生率、分母、检测方式或治疗效果。
unique_evidence.limitation_zh: Crossref无摘要正文；会议/期刊官网访问受限，未核对报告正文、海报、具体会议归属及联合组/单药组分母。不能称为已审WCLC或ESMO大会结果，也不能作为自动用药匹配依据。

unique_evidence.title: 514MO Acquired mechanisms of resistance to first-line (1L) osimertinib with or without platinum-based chemotherapy (CT) in EGFR-mutated (EGFRm) advanced NSCLC: Preliminary data from FLAURA2
unique_evidence.authors: C.K. Lee; J.P. Robichaux; P.A. Jänne; S-W. Kim; T.M. Kim; K. Kobayashi; D. Planchard; S. Sugawara; N. Yanagitani; T-Y. Yang; A. Markovets; P. Bhetaryia; L. Poole; Y. Rukazenkov; R.J. Hartmaier; J.C-H. Yang
unique_evidence.main_finding_zh: 已从Crossref核实题名、作者、期刊、DOI及发表年月：这是一条真实的FLAURA2耐药探索分析会议摘要题录。仅据题录不提取任何RAS/BRAF发生率、分母、检测方式或治疗效果。
